personality: 5 Brutalist Mobile fused with 7 Dark-First Utility influences
personality_one_liner: An industrial, hyper-functional field tool prioritizing absolute clarity, massive touch targets, and truthful offline status over aesthetic fluff.

spacing.rule: Generous and forgiving for gloved hands and jolting environments. Minimum 56pt height for any interactive element.

dont's: No glassmorphism. Causes contrast degradation in high-glare outdoor environments.

screens.name: Sign In
screens.purpose: Secure authentication to access the contractor's assigned sites and data.

states.error: Inline error message above login fields + clear retry button.

screens.layout: Hero image banner (industrial tracks) stacked above a high-contrast auth form. Heavy, 56pt primary button for Sign In.

screens.name: Site List & Prepare
screens.purpose: Select a site and bundle data for offline use.

states.empty: Illustration of a map + 'No sites assigned for today.'

screens.layout: Vertical list of heavy border cards. Each card displays site name, address, and explicit 'Offline ready' status with timestamp (using icon + text). Primary bottom sticky CTA to 'Prepare Offline Bundle' for selected site.

screens.name: Visit Capture
screens.purpose: The primary data collection hub at a site (photos, audio, notes).

states.error: Error message when local save fails.

screens.layout: Dashboard grid of massive square buttons or stacked 56pt full-width buttons (Add Photo, Record, Note, Measurement, Not Inspected). Extremely explicit 'Saved on this device' toast/footer upon local commit.

screens.name: Photo Candidate Review
screens.purpose: Validate AI-extracted info from captured photos.

states.error: Failed analysis state with 'Request closer photo' CTA.

screens.layout: Full-screen photo view with a bounded, high-contrast highlighted region overlay. Sticky bottom sheet displaying extracted field + 4 massive action buttons (Confirm, Correct, Dismiss, Request closer photo).

screens.name: Proposed Fields Review
screens.purpose: Review excerpts and resolve discrepancies found in site data.
screens.layout: Side-by-side or stacked card design showing 'Proposed' vs 'Current' data. Distinct radio-style selection to resolve conflicts.

screens.name: Departure Check
screens.purpose: Wizard-like check before leaving site to ensure completeness.
screens.layout: Paginating wizard (one question per screen). Massive typography for the question. Large block buttons for 'Answer' or 'Needs estimator input'. Progress indicator at the top.

screens.name: Submit Visit

states.loading: Submitting state with active progress bar.
states.error: Error block listing issues preventing submission.

screens.layout: Summary screen listing readiness labels (Provided, Missing, Unknown, etc.). The 'Submit Visit' sticky bottom CTA is disabled if uploads are incomplete or required fields are missing.

screens.name: Outbox
screens.purpose: Transparently display the sync states of all data moving from device to server.

states.error: List of items with 'Blocked' or 'Retry wait' states.

screens.layout: List view where each row specifies item type, timestamp, and a brutally explicit state label (e.g., [ ⏳ Queued ], [ ⬆️ Uploading ], [ ⚠️ Uploaded unverified ]). Explicit 'Sync Now' global CTA.

screens.name: Office Inbox (Estimator)
screens.purpose: Web/Tablet-friendly view for estimators to review incoming and submitted visits.
screens.layout: Master-detail view or wide list layout displaying 'Submitted' vs 'Draft transfers' with strong visual grouping and thick dividers.

screens.name: Visit Review (Estimator)
screens.purpose: Deep dive into a specific site visit from the office.
screens.layout: Content-heavy dashboard. Sections separated by thick `borderStrong` dividers. High-contrast typography for field excerpts and measurements.

login_hero.alt: Railway tracks leading into a forest, industrial vibe

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure the `theme.ts` file is updated to include the `dark` theme alongside `light`. Use the `colorDark` block provided in this JSON to populate the dark theme values.
Do NOT use @expo-google-fonts. Rely entirely on the system font for maximum reliability and a plain, unbranded industrial aesthetic.
All interactive touch targets (buttons, list rows) MUST be a minimum of 56pt height to accommodate gloved hands.
Avoid glassmorphism completely. Rely on solid colors, thick borders (`borderStrong`), and high contrast for elevation and separation.
Status indicators must ALWAYS combine an icon with text (e.g. '💾 Saved on this device', '⏳ Queued'). Never rely solely on color to convey state.
The Outbox screen must clearly differentiate between offline storage states and network states (e.g. Saved Locally vs. Uploading vs. Verified).
Adhere to Stack Navigation only. Do not introduce bottom tabs to maximize the usable screen space for forms and lists.
Ensure strict adherence to WCAG AA contrast, particularly since this app is used outdoors in direct sunlight.
